title: GUARD: Natural Forgetting in Large Reasoning Models via Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.21677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have made machine unlearning more challenging, as protected facts or unsafe rationales may surface in intermediate chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before the final answer is produced. Existing unlearning objectives typically suppress the target content or redirect internal representations, but they never specify how the post-forgetting trajectory should continue, which can lead to hallucinated substitutes, malformed boundaries, or repetitive outputs. We argue that LRM unlearning should instead learn a natural forgetting trajectory: a coherent non-disclosing CoT followed by a stable refusal-style answer that replace the original disclosure. To this end, we propose Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation (GUARD), which converts model-generated unsafe disclosures into safe-exit trajectories, aligns a frozen LRM via guidance tokens, and distills the guided behavior into model parameters.To address

translated_title: GUARD：通过引导式答案-推理蒸馏实现大型推理模型的自然遗忘
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRM）的最新进展使机器遗忘变得更加具有挑战性，因为受保护的事实或不安全的推理依据可能在最终答案产生之前就出现在中间的思维链（CoT）轨迹中。现有的遗忘目标通常只是抑制目标内容或重定向内部表示，但从未指定遗忘后的轨迹应如何继续，这可能导致幻觉性替代内容、畸形的边界或重复输出。我们认为，LRM 的遗忘应该转而学习一种自然的遗忘轨迹：一段连贯的不泄露信息的思维链，随后是一个稳定的拒绝式答案，以取代原始的泄露内容。为此，我们提出了引导式答案-推理蒸馏（GUARD），该方法将模型生成的不安全泄露内容转换为安全退出轨迹，通过引导词元对冻结的 LRM 进行对齐，并将引导后的行为蒸馏到模型参数中。
tldr: 该论文提出 GUARD 方法，通过将模型生成的不安全泄露内容转化为安全退出轨迹，并将这种引导行为蒸馏到模型参数中，使大型推理模型学会“自然遗忘”——即生成不泄露信息的思维链加稳定的拒绝式答案，从而避免幻觉替代、畸形边界或重复输出等问题。
en_tdlr: GUARD converts model-generated unsafe disclosures into safe-exit trajectories and distills this guided behavior into model parameters, enabling large reasoning models to learn a natural forgetting trajectory—a coherent non-disclosing CoT followed by a stable refusal-style answer—rather than merely suppressing target content.
